blockers.humanAction: An authorized read-only Shopify observer records and fingerprints the exact candidate variants.
blockers.resumePoint: Update the Draft Product Release Record with the sanitized Shopify variant fingerprint, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: The Product Owner or named designee reviews the canonical product, price, availability, and variant facts.
blockers.resumePoint: Apply the accepted commerce-facts fingerprint to the Draft Product Release Record under separate authorization, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: The Product Owner or named designee reviews the exact sanitized Shopify observation envelope.
blockers.resumePoint: Apply the accepted candidate observation fingerprint and durable review evidence to the Draft Product Release Record under separate authorization, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: Bind the reviewed observation evidence fingerprint to this exact release and candidate commit.
blockers.resumePoint: Replace the loose, stale, or cross-candidate review reference before re-evaluating staging.

blockers.humanAction: An authorized provider observer verifies every fulfillment variant mapping.
blockers.resumePoint: Record sanitized provider variant fingerprints for every mapping, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: An authorized provider observer reviews the exact product, design, decoration, and variant mapping envelope.
blockers.resumePoint: Record the sanitized provider-mapping fingerprint without ordering or enabling fulfillment, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: Select an immutable candidate commit without merging or deploying it.
blockers.resumePoint: Record the candidate Git commit in the Product Release Record, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: Fingerprint the exact release-bound Media Registry manifest for the immutable candidate.
blockers.resumePoint: Record the manifest SHA-256 binding without changing any media approval, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: Run the approved local quality/build gate for the immutable candidate.
blockers.resumePoint: Bind the passing machine-readable build evidence fingerprint to this release and candidate commit, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: Restore or select an authorized private staging surface and verify the candidate.
blockers.resumePoint: Bind desktop/mobile staging evidence to this release and candidate commit without promoting Production, then re-evaluate staging.

blockers.humanAction: Fingerprint the complete candidate truth envelope after every bound input is final.
blockers.resumePoint: Record the derived release-evidence fingerprint for this exact release and candidate; never reuse it across candidates.
